An '''individual''' was a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He served as a guard in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was stationed aboard the [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] immediately after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="TAB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'' to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> The Gotal guarded the hatchway of a meeting room in which the Rebels [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] watched a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] detailing an [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruu]] species. When Skywalker exited the meeting, the Gotal saluted, but also flinched; his cone-shaped perceptor [[Cones|horns]] reacted to Skywalker's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] with a buzzing sensation inside the Gotal's head.<ref name="TAB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal appeared in ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'', a [[1994]] novel written by [[Kathy Tyers]].<ref name="TAB" />
